name: Ash Helos
source:
An overzealous woman who worships Granleyd's Empress, Esteria, to a fanatical degree. She is the Commander of Granleyd's military forces. Though she is Milia's direct superior, she possesses a completely different mindset. She shows no mercy to the Empress' enemies, and her fervent enthusiasm for matters related to Esteria sometimes invite fear from even her own allies.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
